name: echo-steps-garbage-collector
description: A minimalist arcade survival game where your past moves become enemies.

scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:backend && npm run test:browser
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --directory dist
